=== THE MODIFICATION ===============================================================================

src/constants.rs, WSS_URL only:

  before  wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=<key>&ConnectionId=
  after   wss://api.msedgeservices.com/tts/cognitiveservices/websocket/v1?Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key=<key>&ConnectionId=

The key is the same value. Everything `build_websocket_request` appends (the ConnectionId, Sec-MS-GEC,
Sec-MS-GEC-Version), every header, and the synthesis protocol (speech.config + ssml messages, the
turn.start / response / audio.metadata / turn.end replies) are untouched. VOICE_LIST_URL is untouched.

WHY. From 2026-10-10 the original host refuses a large share of WebSocket handshakes with HTTP 403 —
other clients reported the same from that date, total in some regions and intermittent in others — while
Microsoft Edge itself connects to the host above. Measured from a Windows desktop on 2026-10-12 with this
crate's own request: the original host refused 16 of 40 handshakes made back to back, in streaks; the new
host accepted 45 of 45 valid handshakes and completed every synthesis tried, Arabic voices, 1,284-character
text and word-boundary metadata included.

WHY THE VOICE LIST STAYS. Measured the same day: the original voice-list URL answered 8 of 8 requests
(322 voices, 32 Arabic). The new host's voice list refuses a request without Sec-MS-GEC, which this crate's
voice-list call does not send. There is no evidence that it needs to move, so it does not.

KNOWN LIMIT. The new host requires the v1 Sec-MS-GEC token this crate generates and refuses a
"2-..." Sec-MS-GEC-Version; Edge's own builds have been reported using a newer scheme. If Microsoft stops
accepting v1 tokens, this host will fail like the original one did, and the fix is a token change, not
a host change.


=== RE-VENDORING / REMOVING ========================================================================

Remove this directory and the [patch.crates-io] entry once an upstream msedge-tts release connects to a
working host. To re-vendor: copy the four items above from the new published crate, re-apply the change
(or none), update this file, and check the copy against the published crate file by file — the only
expected differences are the ones recorded here. tests/unit/ttsEndpoint.test.ts pins both URLs.
